visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young man with short dark hair wearing a dark blue button-down shirt. A green banner with text and an illustration of a man and a microphone is fixed at the top of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a press conference-style setting. A woman with dark hair is looking down at white papers, reading them aloud. In the background, there are other individuals in professional attire, including a man with glasses. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional meeting room. (3) The man in the dark shirt reappears, continuing his discussion. He gestures with his hands held together and then opens them wide. He looks directly at the camera, his facial expressions shifting from serious to a slight smile as he explains historical data. The setting remains the indoor room with a laptop partially visible in the foreground. (4) A close-up shot shows a document titled "CONTRACT SUBJECT" lying on a textured surface. The document contains dense legal text in English. This is followed by a cut back to the man in the blue shirt, who points his finger and uses expressive hand movements to list various legal points. Some people are holding up signs with Chinese and English text, such as "JUSTICE FOR GEORGE." visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 臺灣過去經歷. [Logo]: 很有畫面感的臺灣史. (2) [Subtitle]: 戒嚴的時間. (3) [Subtitle]: 比現在. (4) [Subtitle]: 解嚴的時間. (5) [Subtitle]: 還要長. (6) [Variety]: 真的假的. (7) [Subtitle]: 臺灣是在1949年 宣布戒嚴. (8) [Subtitle]: 一直到1987年7月15號 正式的取消戒嚴. (9) [Subtitle]: 長達38年. (10) [Subtitle]: 一直到今年的9月10號 我們就正式經歷 解嚴時間跟戒嚴時間有黃金交叉. (11) [Variety]: 這是歷史性的一刻. (12) [Subtitle]: 提到解嚴 大家有時候會有些誤會 認為說 解嚴了 臺灣就民主了. (13) [Subtitle]: 欸 並不是這樣! 臺灣解嚴歸解嚴. (14) [Subtitle]: 但是許多 限制人民權利的法律 都還在. (15) [Subtitle]: 例如我們的憲法 上面還是有 動員戡亂時期臨時條款. (16) [Subtitle]: 還有 懲治叛亂條例 檢肅匪諜條例 刑法100條. (17) [Subtitle]: 這些限制人民權利的 法律都在. (18) [Subtitle]: 所以在1987年解嚴之後 臺灣其實還是發生了 一些政治事件. (19) [Subtitle]: 一直等到1990年代初期 那些法律拆彈成功 臺灣才慢慢的走向民主. (20) [Subtitle]: 所以我們會說臺灣是一個 民主化的過程. (21) [Variety]: 民主得來不易耶. (22) [Subtitle]: 7月15號 解嚴紀念日 雖然沒有放假 但畢竟是臺灣 民主化重要一步 還是值得我們 稍微瞭解一下這段歷史. (23) [Slogan]: 留言「解嚴」 告訴你更多相關資訊哦.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers about the history of martial law in Taiwan, clarifying that the end of martial law did not immediately result in full democracy due to lingering restrictive laws. It encourages viewers to acknowledge 'Martial Law Lifted Day' as a significant step in Taiwan's democratization process.
